CodeLima 0.3.0 promotes the application code from `v0.3.0-beta.3` to the regular
release. It includes the libghostty-vt renderer, static renderer worker,
terminal search and selection, bounded static graphics, renderer recovery,
and the verified macOS input and native capability packaging fixes.

Upgrade your existing Homebrew installation:

```sh
brew update
brew upgrade codelima
codelima daemon update
codelima --version
```

For a new installation, run `brew install brianrackle/codelima/codelima`.
The separate `codelima-beta` formula is retired. If you installed it, first
install or upgrade regular `codelima` and update the daemon using the regular
CLI (`"$(brew --prefix codelima)/bin/codelima" daemon update`), then run
`brew uninstall codelima-beta` and remove any beta-specific PATH
entry from your shell configuration. Your existing CodeLima home is reused.

**Qualification status:** the maintainer explicitly requested this regular
promotion after approving beta publication with disclosed incomplete QA.
Beta.3 passed native Go verification, race, daemon integration, and package
tests on macOS arm64 and Linux amd64/arm64. This release reruns those gates.
Manual macOS, actual Homebrew installation/upgrade, Lima VM/forwarding, and
interactive multi-window keyboard/graphics checks remain unverified. The full
upstream Ghostty Debug suite remains unverified after exhausting the
development guest's memory. These checks remain tracked in TODO #41/#43/#44;
promotion does not mark them complete. See the
[qualification report](https://github.com/brianrackle/codelima/blob/v0.3.0/plans/regular_release_qa.md).

Archives include both `codelima` and `codelima-renderer-worker`; keep them
together for manual installations. Supported targets are macOS arm64,
Linux amd64, and Linux arm64.
